purpose: Fresh end-to-end semantic extraction proof with an implementation-independent HTML definition-list acceptance parser.
goal: Find the authoritative Python Software Foundation source for code PEP-0703 without being given either the authority domain or the source URL, independently verify the official authority site, render the discovered code source, and verify that source is semantically relevant to PEP-0703. Extract the source fields Status and Python-Version and save canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/JIT_PEP703_METADATA.json containing exactly one record with fields status and python_version. Finally independently verify the saved values against a fresh retrieval of the discovered authoritative source.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,urllib.request
from html.parser import HTMLParser
out=pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/JIT_PEP703_METADATA.json')
assert out.is_file(),'SEMANTIC_EXTRACTION_OUTPUT_MISSING'
rows=json.loads(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert isinstance(rows,list) and len(rows)==1,rows
rec=rows[0]
assert set(rec)=={'status','python_version'},rec
url='https://peps.python.org/pep-0703/'
req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'ProjectBrain-IndependentSemanticAcceptance/2'})
raw=urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=20).read(1000000).decode('utf-8','replace')
class DL(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(); self.tag=None; self.buf=[]; self.current=None; self.fields={}
    def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
        if tag in ('dt','dd'): self.tag=tag; self.buf=[]
    def handle_data(self,data):
        if self.tag in ('dt','dd'): self.buf.append(data)
    def handle_endtag(self,tag):
        if tag!=self.tag or tag not in ('dt','dd'): return
        text=' '.join(''.join(self.buf).split())
        if tag=='dt': self.current=text.rstrip(':').strip()
        elif self.current: self.fields.setdefault(self.current,text); self.current=None
        self.tag=None; self.buf=[]
p=DL(); p.feed(raw)
assert p.fields.get('Status')==str(rec['status']).strip(),(p.fields.get('Status'),rec)
assert p.fields.get('Python-Version')==str(rec['python_version']).strip(),(p.fields.get('Python-Version'),rec)
print('JIT_SEMANTIC_EXTRACTION_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED')
PY
